prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1127; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the collision. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury, and the patient has no known prior injury to this body region. Care was delivered over nineteen visits and followed a typical course of conservative management, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Pain and functional limitations improved steadily, and visit frequency tapered as the patient progressed toward discharge. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated billing observed. At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-normal shoulder mobility and strength, with residual symptoms that were mild and activity-limited. Continued home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
